contracts.title: Complex manifolds, holomorphic bundles and observations
contracts.supplied: Complex inverse/implicit-function and tangent calculus; holomorphic germs and one-variable meromorphic germs; holomorphic bundle/sheaf equivalence and nonsingular flat connections/local systems; projective charts.
contracts.owned_here: The nonlinear-connection theory owns nonlinear connections, holomorphic ODEs, transport and observations. The meromorphic-moduli theory owns meromorphic/analytic-moduli comparisons. K4 does not supply algebraic analytification.
contracts.supplied_ja: 複素逆・陰関数と接束計算、正則芽・一変数有理型芽、正則束と層の同値、非特異な平坦接続と局所系、射影空間のチャート。非線形接続と正則ODEは非線形接続の一般理論、解析化と有理型比較は有理型接続モジュライの一般理論が担う。

contracts.title: Smooth bundle and connection foundations
contracts.supplied: Smooth Ehresmann splittings, proper-submersion and principal-connection transport within their respective hypotheses.
contracts.owned_here: 0.1–0.5 own nonlinear connection objects, continuous-time local lifting, holomorphic parameter dependence and complete nonlinear transport. No properness of the phase projection is assumed.
contracts.supplied_ja: 滑らかなEhresmann分裂、固有沈め込みおよび主接続の移送を、それぞれの仮定の範囲で用いる。一般の非線形移送は0.1–0.5が担う。

contracts.title: Smooth differential calculus and flows
contracts.supplied: Finite-dimensional manifolds, charts and smooth local/maximal/time-dependent flows.
contracts.owned_here: 0.2 proves the continuous-time locally uniformly Lipschitz theorem; 0.8 constructs intrinsic jets.
contracts.supplied_ja: 有限次元多様体・チャート・滑らかな局所／極大／時間依存flow。連続時間・相変数局所一様Lipschitzの定理は0.2、一階jetは0.8で証明する。

contracts.title: Covering spaces and universal covers
contracts.supplied: Native covering, path and homotopy lifting, universal covers and their fundamental-group interfaces.
contracts.owned_here: 0.5 constructs the nonlinear action and horizontal descent; general-cover descent uses the actual fiber relation, not deck invariance without normality.
contracts.supplied_ja: 既存の被覆・経路とホモトピーの持上げ・普遍被覆・基本群。非線形作用と水平降下は0.5で構成し、非正規被覆では実際のファイバー関係を用いる。

contracts.title: Marked-curve charts
contracts.supplied: Genus-zero Möbius normalization and supported point-pushing; stable marked-curve deformation charts in the stable range.
contracts.owned_here: 1.2 constructs unstable one-/two-pointed quotient charts, finite jets, local markings and determinant transport. Its analytic category is constructed there; D2.0 is only an instance comparison.
contracts.supplied_ja: 種数0のMöbius正規化と点の移動、安定範囲の標識曲線変形チャート。1・2標点の商チャート、有限jet、局所標識、行列式移送は1.2が構成する。

contracts.title: Stacks, inertia and restricted coarse-space criteria
contracts.supplied: Stackification, 2-fiber products, algebraic/DM presentations, inertia, QCoh descent, and finite-inertia Keel–Mori at its hypotheses.
contracts.owned_here: 1.3 proves bounded GIT, scalar Gm rigidification, gerbe and coarse comparisons. Finite-inertia criteria do not apply to an unrigidified Gm stable stack.
contracts.supplied_ja: スタック化・2ファイバー積・慣性・準連接層降下・有限慣性のKeel–Mori。Gmの剛化、GIT、gerbeと粗モジュライの比較は1.3が証明する。

contracts.title: Quotient predicates
contracts.supplied: Categorical/geometric quotient definitions, Artin bootstrap and the stated finite-group projective quotients.
contracts.owned_here: Reductive invariant theory and actual character quotients are 1.3/2.5; wild framing and Stokes quotients are 4.2.
contracts.supplied_ja: 圏論的商・幾何学的商の定義と明記された有限群商。簡約群の不変式と指標商は1.3/2.5、Stokesの商は4.2で構成する。

contracts.title: Quot/Hilbert and parameter schemes
contracts.supplied: Noetherian projective Quot/Hilbert and Hom/Isom parameter spaces with their stated base-change laws.
contracts.owned_here: 1.3 proves boundedness, the equations and stability/GIT comparison. Analytic pullbacks use 1.2.
contracts.supplied_ja: Noetherian・射影的なQuot/HilbertとHom/Isom空間。接続の有界性・方程式・安定性は1.3、解析的引戻しは1.2が担う。

contracts.title: Cohomology, duality and curve degree
contracts.supplied: Čech and sheaf cohomology, coherent terms, relative/Serre duality, degrees and curve Riemann–Roch at the stated hypotheses.
contracts.owned_here: 1.4 constructs C-linear differential-operator hypercohomology and the ramified cone; coherent underlying terms do not make its differential O-linear.
contracts.supplied_ja: Čech・層コホモロジー、連接な項、相対・Serre双対、次数・曲線Riemann–Roch。ℂ線形微分作用素の全複体と分岐の錐は1.4が構成する。

contracts.title: Elementary deformation theory
contracts.supplied: Artinian coefficients, deformation functors, hulls and elementary small-extension obstruction calculations.
contracts.owned_here: 1.4 constructs actual connection cocycles, the needed arbitrary finite square-zero kernels and framed versality; 2.1 constructs strong horizontal extensions.
contracts.supplied_ja: Artin係数・変形関手・hull・基本的小拡大の障害。実際の接続コサイクルと平方零核・versal比較は1.4、強い水平延長は2.1で証明する。

contracts.title: Algebraic vector bundles and finite locally free sheaves
contracts.supplied: Finite locally free sheaves, duals/tensors/determinants, relative Spec and the geometric vector-bundle equivalence.
contracts.owned_here: Meromorphic connections and analytification are 1.1–1.2.
contracts.supplied_ja: 有限局所自由層、双対・テンソル・行列式、相対Specと幾何学的ベクトル束との同値。接続と解析化は1.1–1.2が担う。

contracts.title: Coherent analytic module sheaves
contracts.supplied: Coherent analytic module-sheaf carriers and local calculus on the supplied analytic manifold structure sheaf.
contracts.owned_here: 1.2 constructs general complex analytic spaces, nilpotent quotients, analytification and GAGA comparisons.
contracts.supplied_ja: 与えられた解析多様体の構造層上の連接解析加群。冪零元を含む一般複素解析空間、解析化、GAGA比較は1.2が構成する。

contracts.title: Proper coherent direct images and base change
contracts.supplied: Proper coherent pushforwards and separately stated flat-base-change and cohomology/base-change criteria; Grauert under its reduced-base and constant-rank assumptions.
contracts.owned_here: 1.5 proves the relative Picard extension; 5.3 verifies boundary-coefficient flatness and the exact locally free/arbitrary-base-change criterion.
contracts.supplied_ja: 固有連接直像と、各仮定を区別した平坦基底変換・コホモロジー基底変換。相対Picard拡張は1.5、境界係数と任意基底変換の検証は5.3が担う。

contracts.title: Picard over a field and Picard foundations
contracts.supplied: Picard representability for projective geometrically integral schemes over a field, smooth-curve Jacobians, line-bundle descent and deformation.
contracts.owned_here: 1.5 constructs relative Picard under projective flat finite presentation and universal functions, including nonreduced curves; 5.1 verifies its boundary hypotheses.
contracts.supplied_ja: 体上の射影的幾何学的整スキームのPicard、滑らかな曲線のJacobian、線束降下・変形。非被約曲線を含む相対Picardは1.5が構成する。

contracts.title: Cohomology with supports
contracts.supplied: Supported cohomology, localization/excision and the Noetherian colimit-of-Ext comparison with native local cohomology.
contracts.owned_here: 5.3 constructs its first boundary layer, injection and time-line comparison; it does not identify all supported cohomology with that line.
contracts.supplied_ja: 台付きコホモロジー、局所化・切除、NoetherianなExt余極限との比較。第一境界層・注入・時間直線は5.3が構成する。

contracts.title: Divisors, modifications and surface intersections
contracts.supplied: Divisor/Picard groups, blowups and strict transforms, normal crossings, surface intersection/adjunction and lattice theory.
contracts.owned_here: 5.1–5.3 construct the nonreduced anticanonical boundary, relative logarithmic deformation and family comparisons; targets 5.4–5.6 construct the geometric transformations.
contracts.supplied_ja: 因子・Picard群、ブローアップ・狭義変換、正規交叉、曲面交点・随伴・格子。非被約境界と相対変形は目標5.1–5.3、変換は目標5.4–5.6が担う。

contracts.title: Formal scalar and vector-valued Laurent algebra
contracts.supplied: Formal substitutions, continuous differentials, finite-dimensional HahnModule comparisons, residue/duality, ramified exponent embeddings and the stated finite-extension algebra.
contracts.owned_here: 1.1 proves differential-module Levelt–Turrittin decomposition and descent.
contracts.supplied_ja: 形式代入・連続微分・有限次元HahnModule・留数・分岐と有限拡大の代数。微分加群標準形と降下は1.1が担う。

contracts.title: Native complex Fredholm and determinant carriers
contracts.supplied: Scalar-generic finite-dimensional kernel/cokernel, stabilization coordinates and pointwise determinant-line comparisons; specialize over ℂ and dualize the convention.
contracts.owned_here: 6.1 constructs the holomorphic family, canonical section, transition cocycle and base-change laws.
contracts.supplied_ja: 体を複素数に特殊化できる核・余核・安定化と各点の行列式線。双対規約を用い、正則な族・標準切断・コサイクルは6.1が構成する。

contracts.title: Native analytic inversion
contracts.supplied: Analytic inversion on units of a complete normed algebra and the small-norm inverse.
contracts.owned_here: 6.1 proves the actual holomorphic family-to-operator maps used in stabilization.
contracts.supplied_ja: 完備ノルム代数の可逆元における解析的逆写像。安定化に用いる実際の正則族と作用素の比較は6.1が証明する。

contracts.title: Trace-class ideal carrier
contracts.supplied: Normed complete trace-class ideal, nuclear gauge and two-sided ideal estimates.
contracts.owned_here: 6.3–6.4 verify actual trace-class realizations and their trace-norm holomorphic dependence where used.
contracts.supplied_ja: 完備なトレースクラス・イデアルとノルム評価。実際のRHPからの実現と、そのトレースノルムでの正則依存性は6.3–6.4が担う。

contracts.title: Generic trace-class determinant
contracts.supplied: Trace, exterior powers, generic Fredholm determinant series and trace-norm continuity before the positive-kernel point-process specialization.
contracts.owned_here: 6.4 proves the logarithmic derivative, its holomorphic-family hypotheses and the integrable-kernel comparison.
contracts.supplied_ja: 正の核への特殊化以前の一般的なトレース・外冪・Fredholm行列式級数・トレースノルム連続性。正則族の仮定と変分比較は6.4が担う。

contracts.title: Matrix-symbol Toeplitz index
contracts.supplied: Circle Hardy models and Fredholm index equal to minus determinant winding for continuous invertible matrix symbols.
contracts.owned_here: 6.3 constructs contour/Hardy, holomorphic-family, index-zero, resonant and ramified adapters. Index zero alone does not imply invertibility.
contracts.supplied_ja: 円周Hardy模型と可逆行列記号の指数＝行列式回転数の負。6.3が実際の積分路・正則族・共鳴・分岐の比較を構成する。

contracts.title: Native meromorphic functions on Riemann surfaces
sections: Nonconstant curve pullback and order comparison
contracts.supplied: Holomorphic maps from a Riemann surface to OnePoint ℂ with a witness excluding the constant-infinity map; native pullback and orders.
contracts.owned_here: 0.7 proves phase-observation admissibility and scalar descent; its scalar output uses this same carrier.
contracts.supplied_ja: Riemann面からOnePoint ℂへの正則写像と恒等的無限大を除く証人、引戻し・位数。相空間の観測許容性とスカラー降下は0.7が証明し、同じ関数の対象を用いる。

contracts.title: Native topological properness
contracts.supplied: Topological proper maps and the compact-preimage and base-change properties under their actual topological hypotheses.
contracts.owned_here: 0.4 proves complete-lift transfer. 1.2 proves analytic/algebraic comparison; 4.4 proves properness of the actual RH family.
contracts.supplied_ja: 位相的固有写像と各仮定の下でのコンパクト逆像・基底変換。水平延長は0.4、解析比較は1.2、RH族の固有性は4.4が証明する。

contracts.title: Native real Frobenius product coordinates
contracts.supplied: For a finite-dimensional real integrable graph field, a local product OpenPartialHomeomorph with a smooth inverse and the prescribed horizontal derivatives, at the stated regularity.
contracts.owned_here: 0.5 constructs the submersion-chart graph field, proves curvature implies its integrability, and glues these local products for homotopy-invariant transport. 0.3 supplies the holomorphic counterpart.
contracts.supplied_ja: 有限次元の実可積分グラフ場から、明記した正則性の下で、滑らかな逆写像と水平微分を持つ局所積OpenPartialHomeomorphを得る。0.5が沈め込み座標への移送、曲率から可積分性、貼合せとホモトピー不変性を証明し、正則版は0.3を用いる。

contracts.title: Chow lemma for the proper GAGA proof
contracts.supplied: For a separated finite-type morphism to a Noetherian base, a projective modification with quasi-projective source over that base; the source is projective when the original morphism is proper.
contracts.owned_here: 1.2 uses this subtarget with coherent cohomology and proper direct images for the proper GAGA argument. The separate flattening and StableReduction branch of 4.12 is not a prerequisite.
contracts.supplied_ja: Noetherian基底への有限型分離射に対し、基底上準射影的となる射影的改変を供給し、元の射が固有なら改変後は基底上射影的となる。1.2はこの小目標と連接コホモロジー・固有直像をGAGAの証明に用い、4.12の別の平坦化・StableReductionの分岐は前提にしない。
